results.title: Eye-gaze and dwell - Mixed Reality | Microsoft Learn
results.content: A hands-free interaction alternative for selecting holograms is "eye-gaze and dwell" or in other words: *"look and stare"*. The user simply keeps looking at the target they would like to select and different dwell feedback is displayed to indicate the process. If the dwell time is too short: The user may feel overwhelmed by having holograms react to their eye-gaze all the time. If the dwell time is too long: The experience may feel too slow and interruptive as the user has to keep looking at targets for a long time. 2. *Start dwell feedback:* After ensuring that the user is intentionally looking at the target, start showing dwell feedback to inform the user that the dwell activation is being initiated.
